latin: Corporalis natura est in intellectu immobiliter, in animo ex se primo mobiliter, in animali ex se mobiliter participatiue, in coelo aliunde ordinate mobiliter, infra lunam aliunde mobiliter inordinate.
translation: Corporeal nature exists in intellect immovably; in the [world-]soul, of itself, movably in the first instance; in the animate being, of itself, movably by participation; in the heavens, movably in an ordered way from elsewhere; below the moon, movably in a disordered way from elsewhere.
